title: 3 孙翔任务，叫哥哥
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【检测到目标人物，孙翔。】

【任务生成中，任务已生成。】

【要求：对孙翔叫哥哥，并得到回应。】

周珈蓝呛了一下，抽出手帕捂住嘴巴咳嗽。

经理立刻看过来，然后发现队里年轻人全都看了过来，说说笑笑的餐厅包厢里渐次安静。

他们之前就一直在偷偷看她，穿绿裙子的白色头发小女孩，新队友，天才狂剑士。

这一秒钟几乎所有人都想跟她说话，但是所有人都不知道该说什么。

还好吗，喝点茶吗？……太土了，跟这种女孩子说话能这么土吗？简直是对她的玷污。

她甚至还用手帕，深绿色像天鹅绒手镯垂在她手腕上，映得她容光如雪，清澈明净。

周珈蓝放下手帕，有点不自在地笑了一下，“不好意思，我没事。”

她用手帕不是因为作风老派，或者家教古板，之前有一段时间她总是吐血，纸巾用的很快，要浪费很多钱。

而手帕只需要找个卫生间洗一洗，就可以继续擦新的血。

就像她一直穿那条古板保守的绿裙子，因为要面试，没钱买新衣服，只能穿她妈妈留在衣柜里的唯一一条体面裙子。

而现在她坐在高档餐厅的贵宾席上，面前摆满海胆、和牛、金枪鱼。

起因是越云那位据说要转会的会长。

今晚是他留在越云的最后一天，临走前要请全队吃饭，队友来喊经理吃饭时正撞上周珈蓝签合同。

经理站起来，然后一秒钟的犹豫也没有，“刚好，小周也一起来，那家日料还不错，也见见咱们的队友。”

周珈蓝找不出拒绝的理由。

她签了合同，经理在她的世界里自动晋级成为“大人”，迄今为止她的生存逻辑就是听大人的话。

因为私底下要做很多狡猾的小动作，所以表面上要加倍的听话和柔弱。

况且她今天还没吃饭，只是面试之前在旅馆里吃了一碗泡面。

没有觉得饿，因为已经习惯了，但是白蹭一顿饭吃当然也很好。

在坐到餐桌上之前，周珈蓝没想过会看到人均两千的餐标，一顿饭吃掉上万块，她难以想象。

越云前队长，也既任务目标孙翔，是个看起来很不好惹的人。

金色头发张扬，表情也张扬，个子很高，手臂上有明显的肌肉，五官算得上英俊，但是眉骨突出，鼻梁又过分挺拔，看起来很容易不耐烦发脾气。

而且他竟然打耳钉，两只耳朵上挂了三个钉子，脖子上还戴着黑色十字架项链，浑身衣服上都是大LOGO。

是周珈蓝在路上会躲着走的那种类型，总觉得这种人会用烟头烫她的胳膊。

不过孙翔似乎不抽烟。

周珈蓝已经观察过有一会儿了，越云战队选手有红毛，有潮男，有肥宅，也有老实人，性格各异但整体竟然算得上正常人，席间没人抽烟也没人喝酒。

[The target person is detected, Sun Xiang.】

[Task generation in progress, the task has been generated.】

[Requirement: Call Sun Xiang brother and get a response.】

Zhou Jialan choked, took out his handkerchief and covered his mouth to cough.

The manager immediately looked over, and then found that all the young people in the team looked over, and the restaurant room gradually became quiet as they were chatting and laughing.

They had been secretly watching her before, the little girl with white hair in a green skirt, the new teammate, the genius mad swordsman.

Almost everyone wanted to talk to her at this second, but no one knew what to say.

Are you okay? Can you have some tea?...It’s too tacky. Can you be so tacky when talking to a girl like this?It was simply a disgrace to her.

She even used a handkerchief, dark green like a velvet bracelet hanging on her wrist, reflecting her face as bright and clear as snow.

Zhou Jialan put down the handkerchief and smiled uncomfortably, "Sorry, I'm fine."

She used a handkerchief not because of her old-school style or old-fashioned tutoring. There was a time before when she was always vomiting blood and she used up the paper towels very quickly, which cost a lot of money.

The handkerchief only needs to be washed in a bathroom, and then it can continue to wipe fresh blood.

It's like she has been wearing that conservative green skirt because she has to go to an interview and has no money to buy new clothes, so she can only wear the only decent skirt her mother left in the wardrobe.

And now she is sitting in a VIP seat at a high-end restaurant, with sea urchin, wagyu, and tuna in front of her.

The reason was the president of Yue Yun who was said to be transferring.

Tonight was the last day he stayed in Yueyun. Before leaving, he wanted to treat the whole team to dinner. When his teammates came to call the manager for dinner, they bumped into Zhou Jialan signing the contract.

The manager stood up, and without a second's hesitation, "Just in time, Xiao Zhou is coming too. That Japanese restaurant is pretty good, and we also want to meet our teammates."

Zhou Jialan could not find a reason to refuse.

She signed the contract, and the manager was automatically promoted to "adult" in her world. So far, her survival logic has been to listen to adults.

Because you have to do a lot of cunning tricks in private, you have to be doubly obedient and soft on the surface.

Besides, she hadn't eaten yet today. She just ate a bowl of instant noodles in the hotel before the interview.

I didn’t feel hungry because I was used to it, but of course it was good to have a free meal.

Before sitting at the dining table, Zhou Jialan never thought that she would see a meal price of two thousand yuan per person. It was unimaginable for her to eat tens of thousands of yuan in one meal.

Sun Xiang, the former captain of Yueyun and the target of the mission, seems to be a very difficult person to mess with.

His blond hair is flamboyant, his expression is flamboyant, he is very tall, and his arms have obvious muscles. His facial features are handsome, but his brow bones are prominent and the bridge of his nose is too straight. He seems to be easily impatient and loses his temper.

Moreover, he actually wears earrings, with three nails hanging on each ear, a black cross necklace around his neck, and big LOGOs all over his clothes.

She was the type that Zhou Jialan would avoid on the street. She always felt that such people would burn her arms with cigarette butts.

But Sun Xiang doesn't seem to smoke.

Zhou Jialan has been observing the players for a while. There are red-haired players on the Yueyun Team, some trendy guys, some fat nerds, and some honest guys. They have different personalities, but overall they can be considered normal people. No one smoked or drank during the banquet.
